data.narrative: A critical systemic breach was detected involving unauthorized administrative access to the core banking platform via compromised service account credentials (svc_acct_mgmt). The attacker performed bulk account enumeration and balance queries, indicating preparation for mass fraudulent wire transfers. The breach exploited internal access controls, suggesting potential insider knowledge or credential theft. Due to the compromise of the account management API, individual account freezes were ineffective, necessitating a platform-wide emergency freeze to prevent imminent loss. No funds were transferred prior to containment. This incident is classified as 'insider_abuse' due to the misuse of privileged system credentials. All affected systems have been isolated and an internal investigation is ongoing.
